about_the_game:
Welcome to the Campus, where the excitement of learning meets the warmth of friendship! In this hidden-objects game, explore a vibrant university setting where cats come together to study, collaborate, and enjoy the moments that make campus life special.

From lively study sessions to creative clubs and sports activities, this scene captures the energy of student life. Find curious cats engaged in different pursuits, from deep discussions under shady trees to celebrating new discoveries in the lab. Every corner is filled with details that highlight the joy of learning, teamwork, and exploration.

With no time limits, you can relax and uncover all the hidden surprises at your own pace. Pop balloons for a little extra fun as you navigate this charming academic adventure!

Perfect for cozy game lovers and those who cherish the magic of campus life, Welcome to Campus is a lighthearted experience celebrating knowledge, creativity, and lifelong friendships!

By purchasing this DLC, you can:
- Play a brand-new scene in the main game.
- Add the Welcome to Campus content to your creations in the Community and Creative Maker. You can mix items from all the scenes you own in the same scene!
- Play the scenes created by other players in the Community that include Welcome to Campus items.

You will also support us to create more content and more games!
Thanks in advance!
